note:
The building is called The Weave and it was two stacked boxes. It is four long slabs now, each rotated against the one below and crossing it — a stack you cannot read the corners of, which is the whole of what the name is asking for. ⚠ A ROTATED SLAB CARRIES NOTHING: `anchored` takes its wall planes from UNYAWED boxes, so every part authored here is on the podium and nothing is hung above z 0.11. The slabs are still BOXES though, so they keep their wall texture and their lit windows — which is why this reads as a woven tower after dark rather than as a dark sculpture. See thespire.json for what happens when the same shape is attempted with drums. RENDER_TUNE.legacyArms puts the asc_weave arm back.

⚠ RESTORED TO THE HEIGHT OF ITS ARM (2026-09-17). The form above is unchanged and was
never the problem; what did not carry across from the asc_weave arm was how tall it stands. It was
at 84% — 0.92x the storey stack against the arm's 1.10x — so every 'h'-tagged field
here was multiplied by 1.196 and every 'fh'-tagged one left alone. The silhouette is identical;
only the storeys are taller. Same regression as halcyontowers and thespire, same measurement.

⚠ LIT AT THE JUNCTIONS, WHICH IS WHERE THE FORM IS. Each slab crosses the one below, so the
places light belongs are the ledges those crossings leave — one glow at each, plus the podium.
It emitted two sprites before this. The accent is Ascendant blue rather than the arm’s
welding-spark orange: the arm was an open fab shed and this is not that building any more.
